The '''Twisted Forest''' was the name given to the northern half of the [[Nightmare Lands]] on the [[Planet/Legends|planet]] [[Voss]], between the [[Deepest Woods]] to the south and the uncorrupted [[Crysfang Glade]] to the north beyond the black stone borders of the region. The [[Vile Grotto]] was one of several caves located in the area's deep ravines.<ref name="TOR" />

==Behind the scenes==
The Twisted Forest appears as an area on Voss in the [[2011]] [[Star Wars video games|video game]] ''[[Star Wars: The Old Republic]]''.<ref name="TOR" />
